notizie.titolo: Should You Buy Occidental Petroleum Stock For Its Cash?
notizie.riassunto: Occidental Petroleum (OXY) generates free cash flow equal to 7.8% of its market value per year. That compares with 4.4% for the median S&P 500 company. A yield this high presents a clear binary. Either the shares are cheap for what the business makes, or the market expects that cash to fall. So can Occidental keep that cash coming while it pays down its debt.

notizie.titolo: Has ExxonMobil Stock Become A Different Bet?
notizie.riassunto: At 22.2 times earnings, ExxonMobil (XOM) stock trades near the S&P 500's 22.5. Shareholders paying that multiple need a clear view of the underlying assets, and the priorities inside the company have shifted. During the fiscal Q3 2024 call, executives promoted Pioneer Natural Resources, a producer ExxonMobil now owns outright. Management no longer emphasizes that deal. So what does management talk up instead.
